How to use  ·  Hover a run or a hold (F#) = what it is / what it ties  ·  Click a run (map or list) = focus it; click it again or click empty map = unfocus  ·  Click a hold (F# on the map or in the Holds list) = show only the runs it ties  ·  Tick / untick a run or a group in the list = show / hide; click a group name = show only that group (again = all)  ·  All / None / Power / Signal … buttons = presets  ·  Esc = show everything, no focus  ·  Wheel or + / − = zoom, drag = pan, Fit = whole map  ·  Flip 180° = swap the front / back ends (remembered in this browser)

Power-bay wiring: CEILING build, Halo (Halo's carrier revision f9d5881c: INA-MAIN on native raised posts, no adapter): 4 PIRs + the tether, no phone charger

Halo's carrier f9d5881c; landscape top view, FRONT (PSU end) on the left by default. Yellow squares = terminals; dashed = raised run. F# = tie anchor (black) / standoff tie (orange) / stretch post (blue) / retain tower (olive) / mains tie cap (red) / L-leg tie lug on the fence (purple). SERVICE: to reach the MECCANIXITY breakout screws, cut the stretch-post ties and lift the raised bundle (I2C TMP102->INA3, Mus-14 in) aside. SERVICE: the carrier's front is held by 2 EARS, M3 x 10 pan head self-tap down into the fence's flipped front pads; its back by 4 x M3 x 8 pan head self-tap into the battery bars' tabs (drive the two on the mains side before the mains go in; a slim driver, <= 6 mm). To remove the carrier: lift the PIR leads + the fan PWM + TACH lead (6.7..9.3 from the left ear screw) aside (no unsoldering). SERVICE: the buck ZK-SJ20 sits +5.0 on its end bars, 4 x M3 x 12 pan head self-tap; its heatsink drops through the deck opening (no shims). Its IN / OUT terminals are raised with the board: BUCK-IN / BUCK-OUT land from above, screwdriver straight down beside the LCD. MOUNT ORDER, INA-MAIN: the carrier -> bar screw at (174.6, 62.5) first (INA-MAIN covers it; in before E3), then INA-MAIN on its raised posts (M1.7 x 6 x 2). INA-BATT and INA3 go straight on their own posts (M1.7 x 6 x 2 each). ORDER (tie probe, every board mounted): tie F5 before the breakout; F14 before INA-MAIN + the HL-PBB; F15 before the HL-PBB; F19 before INA-BATT; F3 before the front-left PIR board; F7 / F8 / F9 (round the TMP102 standoffs) before the TMP102. Close from the SIDE: F2, F12, F16. TIES: every deck run is zip-tied to its anchor (snug); mains ties at every tie cap, snug not cinched, mains only, head + trimmed tail on the cap side off the jacket.
